description: Defines the OutboundSignal interface and its nested interfaces and classes, representing outbound signals in a connectivity model, including methods for serialization, target management, and payload mapping.

classes.name: OutboundSignal
classes.description: Interface representing an outbound signal with methods to access source, targets, and serialization.

classes.name: OutboundSignal.Mappable
classes.description: Interface extending OutboundSignal, adding payload mapping information.

classes.name: OutboundSignal.Mapped
classes.description: Interface extending OutboundSignal, adding methods to access the mapped external message and adaptable message.

classes.name: OutboundSignal.MultiMapped
classes.description: Interface for a collection of mapped outbound signals, including methods for accessing the first, list, and sender.

classes.name: OutboundSignal.JsonFields
classes.description: Final class defining JSON field definitions for source, targets, and headers.

methods.name: getTargets
methods.description: Returns the list of targets authorized to read and subscribe to the outbound signal.

methods.name: getExtra
methods.description: Returns extra fields of an enriched signal, relevant during message mapping.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the outbound signal to JSON, including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Serializes the outbound signal to JSON with specified schema version and field selector.

methods.name: getPayloadMapping
methods.description: Returns the payload mapping used to map the signal, part of Mappable interface.

methods.name: getExternalMessage
methods.description: Returns the external message mapped from the outbound signal, part of Mapped interface.

methods.name: getAdaptable
methods.description: Returns the Ditto protocol message after adaptation, part of Mapped interface.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first mapped outbound signal, part of MultiMapped.

methods.name: getMappedOutboundSignals
methods.description: Returns a list of mapped outbound signals, part of MultiMapped.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the sender of the original signal, optional, part of MultiMapped.
